name: Sudarat Sae-heng
bio:
Sudarat's journey into motorsport started with a fascination for aerodynamics, sparked by observing planes at a local airshow as a child. She pursued mechanical engineering, specializing in fluid dynamics, at Chulalongkorn University. After graduating top of her class, she secured an internship at a local automotive manufacturer, where she honed her skills in CFD analysis and wind tunnel testing. Her passion for racing led her to seek opportunities abroad, eventually landing a role with Team WRT. 

In her role as a wind tunnel operator, Sudarat is known for her meticulous approach and ability to correlate simulation data with real-world performance. She's particularly skilled at identifying subtle aerodynamic improvements that can translate to significant gains on the track. She values collaboration and open communication within the team, believing that the best results are achieved when everyone is working together seamlessly. Her dedication and eye for detail make her a valuable asset to the team.

What sets Sudarat apart is her innovative approach to problem-solving. She's always looking for new ways to optimize testing procedures and extract more meaningful data from each run. Her experience with both simulation and physical testing gives her a unique perspective that allows her to bridge the gap between the virtual and real worlds.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair often pulled back into a practical ponytail while working.
physical.description: Sudarat is of average height with a lean build, and usually wears practical, comfortable clothing.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations and ideas.
Has a habit of humming quietly while analyzing data.
Insists on cleaning and organizing her workspace at the end of each shift.
